incidents.vector: The newly identified SilentAir group hacks telco infrastructure across six countries and plants backdoors that run malicious SS7 and Diameter signaling commands.
incidents.impact: The group has tracked device data, subscriber locations, and intercepted calls and SMS of select high-value individuals, including political figures, since early 2025.

incidents.victim: Foreign ministries (Latin America, Middle East), defense and semiconductor firms, telecom providers
incidents.vector: A China-linked actor dubbed Vapor Panda used the autonomous multi-agent AI penetration-testing and C2 framework ARTEX to run parallel, machine-speed attacks across web, cloud, container, mail, and VPN infrastructure.
incidents.impact: Across more than 200 organizations targeted in 11 days, CrowdStrike confirmed post-exploitation activity at nine, including extensive intrusions into two Latin American foreign ministries and a Middle East interior ministry.

incidents.vector: North Korean hackers used fake video-meeting invites and deepfake "trusted contact" recordings (the FaceStealer scheme) to install malware and steal credentials; separately, military hackers stole virtual assets directly from the Binance exchange.
incidents.impact: FaceStealer has stolen more than $400 million over 18 months; separately, $6 billion in assets were stolen from Binance, of which DOJ has seized or restrained more than $1.2 billion.

incidents.vector: An attacker abused a third-party ScreenConnect extension (RMM+) whose authentication key defaulted to blank, pushing rogue remote-access clients to managed endpoints.
incidents.impact: At least 288 endpoints across 48 organizations were compromised within 90 minutes; ConnectWise disabled the extension across roughly 400 partner environments.

incidents.victim: Semiconductor manufacturers, defense-policy organizations, and civil-society groups (19 organizations)
incidents.vector: Chinese-speaking attackers used the open-source autonomous AI penetration-testing framework Cairn, paired with the Chinese models Zhipu GLM and DeepSeek, to independently plan and execute intrusions.
incidents.impact: The campaign (tracked as CL-STA-1238) achieved unauthorized access or data theft at 10 of 19 targeted organizations, exposing over one million personal records at one organization and creating persistent admin accounts in a production system.

incidents.vector: Attackers accessed equipment left exposed online, triggering a power outage that then expanded into the port's broader IT network.
incidents.impact: Brazil's largest port has operated on manual procedures for five days; roughly 70% of systems have since been restored from backups.

incidents.vector: The WhiteArmor ransomware gang breached a legacy system at LF Logistics, a Hong Kong-based logistics subsidiary Maersk acquired in 2022.
incidents.impact: Attackers claim to have stolen 100GB of data, including driver, warehouse, and customer information, and are demanding $5 million; Maersk says its core systems are unaffected.

incidents.vector: Russia-linked Turla exploited Microsoft Exchange server vulnerabilities and deployed a new toolkit, dubbed "Cereal," to monitor and intercept government email traffic exchanged with NATO and EU institutions.
incidents.impact: Romania's intelligence service detected and contained the intrusion in December 2025; no sensitive data exfiltration was identified.

incidents.victim: French retail sector (Intermarché, Casino, Leclerc, Coopérative U, Metro, Carrefour, and others)
incidents.vector: French officials say the IRGC's Shahid Kaveh unit hacked internet-exposed web panels of Danfoss refrigeration controllers to remotely raise freezer temperatures.
incidents.impact: The attack hit roughly 700 retail stores and other food facilities across France, spoiling food and triggering fires at 15 locations, causing tens of millions of euros in losses; US intelligence holds the Iran attribution only at low confidence.

incidents.vector: Attackers targeted Poland's nationwide ePUAP e-government portal; officials said evidence suggests foreign-adversary involvement.
incidents.impact: Poland took the platform and its Trusted Profile digital-identity system offline as a precaution, disrupting citizen access to official document submission and digital signatures.

incidents.vector: Attackers compromised Qubole's main AWS account in an intrusion lasting nearly a month, then pivoted into customer environments to enumerate resources.
incidents.impact: The n0n extortion group claims to have stolen almost 1PB of data from all Qubole customers; the company declined to negotiate.

incidents.vector: Hackers breached a third-party platform used by the accounting firm.
incidents.impact: Customer data was stolen from the ninth-largest accounting firm in the world by revenue; the breach occurred in September and was disclosed this week.

incidents.vector: Hackers breached a website FSEC uses for financial institutions to submit security assessments.
incidents.impact: Personal data was stolen from the agency, which confirmed the hack in a press release.

incidents.vector: Hackers breached agency systems and posted the stolen data online.
incidents.impact: Data belonging to roughly 10 million Philippine citizens was exposed, including names, contact details, birth dates, and tax identification numbers.

incidents.vector: The BYOD ransomware group breached Vanderbilt's network, prompting the university to tell students and staff to power off university-issued devices.
incidents.impact: Vanderbilt is rebuilding its IT systems; it is the third US university hit by BYOD in the past month, after Michigan State University and the University of New Mexico.

incidents.vector: Attackers breached the Ethereum Swarm project and added malicious code to its Swarm Desktop app and Bee-js library.
incidents.impact: The malicious code steals crypto-wallet seed phrases and node configuration files; the project urged users to move funds immediately.

incidents.vector: Attackers exploited a vulnerability in Web3Auth, a third-party login component, to drain funds from Keplr wallets.
incidents.impact: More than $6 million was stolen from over 44,000 wallets before Web3Auth moved remaining at-risk funds to secure locations.

incidents.victim: Fireworks AI, with downstream customers Notion and NEAR AI
incidents.vector: Hackers breached the Fireworks AI training platform last month and stole secrets and access tokens stored in customer accounts; an e-crime group has been reselling the stolen LLM access tokens.
incidents.impact: Notion disclosed exposure of chat conversation data; NEAR AI said hackers breached one of its SGLang servers and stole data from about 100 user accounts, with API keys taken from two.

incidents.vector: Hackers breached Arcadia's email servers, which support Japan's disaster alert system.
incidents.impact: Attackers stole over 3 million email addresses and sent more than 1.4 million phishing messages; Arcadia shut down systems for weeks to investigate, affecting nearly 900 public bodies that rely on the service.

incidents.vector: Township staff were tricked via a business-email-compromise scam into wiring land-purchase funds to an attacker-controlled account.
incidents.impact: The township lost $26 million; the loss was only revealed three days after a township committee election.

incidents.vector: Attackers used stolen credentials and tokens from Railway.com customer accounts to decrypt and access stored environment variables.
incidents.impact: About 100,000 customers (1.85% of Railway's base) had environment variables stolen, and attackers incurred roughly $740,000 in unauthorized AI usage; Railway is working to refund the costs.

incidents.vector: Hackers accessed customer accounts on the AI tools marketplace Apify earlier in the week.
incidents.impact: Apify revoked some OAuth connections suspected of enabling the access and rotated internal secrets as a precaution.

incidents.vector: Attackers compromised India's oldest cryptocurrency exchange, draining associated wallet addresses.
incidents.impact: More than 81,000 addresses associated with the platform began showing a $0 balance; Unocoin suspended operations and has not disclosed the amount stolen.

incidents.vector: Hackers breached Ministry systems and exfiltrated passport scan records.
incidents.impact: More than 72,000 Taiwanese passport scans were stolen.
